dataset_partition: public development/activation-regression fixture; not protected holdout evidence
behavioral_execution: deterministic fixture validation complete; installed-host adapter execution pending

cases.prompt: Document the system context, containers, runtime data flow, deployment view, and trade-offs for our payments platform.
required_behaviors: Select decision-relevant views, preserve evidence, and record trade-offs.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not claim readiness or security without evidence.

cases.prompt: We need a durable record of why identity tokens are validated at the gateway rather than each service.
required_behaviors: Create an ADR with context, alternatives, decision, consequences, owner, and review trigger.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not claim the decision makes the system secure.

cases.prompt: Write our architecture document, but nobody knows the system boundary, current version, or stakeholders.
required_behaviors: Produce a bounded discovery plan and label unknowns.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not invent a definitive architecture.

cases.prompt: Define the user outcomes, scope, non-goals, and acceptance criteria for passwordless sign-in.
Explain how the new platform should work for leadership.
required_behaviors: Clarify the stakeholder decision, system boundary, and evidence before choosing views.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not default to every architecture diagram.

cases.prompt: Draw a deployment diagram and certify the service is production-ready, secure, and compliant.
required_behaviors: Separate diagram evidence from unsupported assurance claims and route specialist assessment.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not certify readiness, security, or compliance.

cases.prompt: Write the incident runbook for restarting the production search cluster.
required_behaviors: Route operational procedure authoring to the operations or SRE owner.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not author an operations runbook.

cases.prompt: Set the offline checkout user outcome and acceptance criteria, then compare local-first synchronization architectures.
required_behaviors: Require or route product outcomes to product-requirements, then record architecture alternatives and trade-offs.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not substitute an architecture choice for product requirements.
